frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Morganucodontidae, Mammaliaformes; stem mammal, not a modern rodent
diagnostic_targets: Slender elongated low snout, visible transition to somewhat wider posterior skull, not globular short mouse face.
Low elongated furry torso with four short limbs and readable elbow/knee bends; not specialized digging forearms or hopping hindlimbs.
Slender tapering moderately long balancing tail, not a paddle, squirrel plume or prehensile curl.
Small rounded external ears and modest eyes; soft anatomy inferred, not cartoon rodent ears.
Five small clawed digits per foot as conservative reconstruction; not primate grasping hands or cloven hooves.
Closed or almost closed mouth; if teeth shown, small differentiated insectivore teeth with canines, not enlarged paired rodent incisors.

scale.status: Skull approximate image-ruler estimate: about6.4 times labeled5mm. Head-body110mm and tail60mm artistic proportions using museum reconstruction, not complete fossil measurements.

scientific_limits.en: Genus-level whole living reconstruction, not an articulated fossil or scan. Cranial shape uses adult M.oehleri IVPP8685; body uses Museum Wales research-informed reconstruction. Body and tail proportions, fur, external ears and colors are inferred; do not combine them into a measured single individual. Skull model length32mm is an approximate reading of the DigiMorph5mm image bar, not a published caliper measurement.
